suggestions.now: **One prompt, `em-install-leadership-memory`.** Builds `team-leadership.md`: ADKAR per person (furthest stage clearly reached + what they need next), adoption-curve tier for the team (chatting → custom assistants → agentic workflows → compounding engineering), every entry tagged and quoting its line; nothing starts as a rule unless the notes say it has been seen repeatedly; thin notes named, not guessed. Decision Journal opens with one dated entry (placements, alternatives for the least certain, confidence baseline). Quality Gate opens with the calibration question as its top gate.
